# BUD-10 Client Adoption Status

| Client | Platform or version | Thread status | Evidence and qualification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Amethyst** | Android; version 1.20.0 explicitly reported | ✅ Working | Five independent positive reports. The final report explicitly says, “Yes. Amethyst 1.20.0.” [1](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqrqwv5rm5xu5yx7r3chmv58r08f7yxun9cz8dy8p860l483x7s80qvaw) [2](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsgvd8y0vh8uemwrdvenymqq0nzpu85nnc77r30c727r3qahzhwuecsevnlw) [3](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsxu6mzcj2n42vtaafy4rfhqyeuzpmnlawv252n65paj9n4lfuwfzsx6vhu6) [4](https://njump.me/nevent1qqs28xzysqhjp3em3fkxn52hmpapn2mj24m44snahtywnv9qc9gupuq4hh855) [5](https://njump.me/nevent1qqs2f7h2rjy8nc3j3arr9vkthk3txyuslr3vl26gld8q459836m4mkgxe4me6) |
| **Feather** | Android; 1.9.0 announced | ✅ Working in 1.9.0 | An initial report said the image was not visible. Feather then announced, “Added BUD-10 support in 1.9.0!” and a user subsequently confirmed, “Yes, now I can see it.” [Initial failure](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqqq2yf2er3dkll5ap7n0y76scsv5jk52xnmzmapd7c08sjaazs7lw5f2) · [Developer announcement](https://njump.me/nevent1qqs0e3gfr6p0dnm3w62d6h6z3kerh4mek3rzcrrym7lxwsfstl8zm4ctgpm56) · [User confirmation](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqqr4xl9wn4k2ph99ch4pj4decqp0z84aj5640474af972af9tszjj696) |
| **Nostr Vault** | Web | ✅ Working according to its developer | About 4 hours 43 minutes after the initial iOS failure, Nostr Vault's creator reported, “This is functional on Nostrvault.app now.” This is a developer statement rather than an independent rendering confirmation. [Developer update](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsf0j4hvpz03e8qurzsevtt0qnkmp92sdxx0hmn67nvx5t5a396kkgcv9dxd) |
| **Nostr Vault** | iOS | ⚠️ Initially failed; current status unconfirmed | The iOS app initially displayed only a link. The subsequent update was posted from an event tagged “Nostr Vault on iOS,” but its text explicitly names Nostrvault.app and does not clearly say whether the iOS app was fixed. A fresh iOS test is needed. [Initial failure](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqzmtwnzlyqg8aenys42jhnkr8vg5tkqhc0mdh0kzxjl6xhf3pq6ypu32) · [Ambiguous update](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsf0j4hvpz03e8qurzsevtt0qnkmp92sdxx0hmn67nvx5t5a396kkgcv9dxd) |
| **Zap Cooking** | Web | 🟡 Announced, not confirmed | The project said, “We will support this very soon in Zap Cooking.” This is an implementation commitment, not evidence that support has shipped. [Announcement](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqptfaqt2syz5m9qk8x5ctq0fmqeu4cxdexc2w223jypu6skvkgg0428c) |
| **Primal** | Web in Chrome and Brave | ❌ Not working in this test | Two independent web users reported no image and raw Blossom text. [Chrome report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqspn5hadenqjyzv6d394ury7yh8ykatd95umw6zs3hu2cazakjg5gsnkw23p) · [Brave report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsyvn950x20slqkg8aveqffk6u4dz3xug4regy8xtyfay7nc5qdwxcpe2nvx) |
| **Primal** | iOS | ❌ Not working in this test | A Primal iOS user explicitly reported that the image was not visible. [Report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsy9g536qezjv9vhtrrg9meg3p0mu5rge7m4htnzunt8eq990adyag37tq22) |
| **Wisp** | Unspecified | ❌ Not working in this test | The participant saw a link and reported that it appeared to break at each query string. The event metadata says only “Wisp,” not a specific platform. [Report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqx3ukvlfu4pjsxgdelr5j8mczy4tveyks9dz0s4gkvr3rt64tsjfwp7e) |
| **Wisp** | iOS | ❌ Not working in this test | The Wisp iOS report said the reference looked like a text string and generalized the failure to every iOS client. Only Wisp iOS is counted here; later evidence showed that the generalization no longer held. [Report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsqqqp2lm3thyzj0yrh2m053zuywj97zjv2vxacpcuruwf39jsfe8q08mcfa) |
| **Jumble** | Web | ❌ Not working in this test | A participant reported “no” while tagging Jumble's official account. [Report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsgvh0gshvlfg4suudy596cg7x9ret269w008k4scvgnn0xecdr9jqj278wg) |
| **T-Bone** | Unspecified | ❌ Not working in this test | A participant associated with the client answered, “No T-Bone,” then shared its v0.5.2 release link. The release link is not itself evidence that this version supports BUD-10. [Failure report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsxez0sdfdu5xkfvqqe6zsdq3rj2m52c6x7x6ja4crpw2kwjuw0kjsyqa77t) · [Follow-up](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsf2mjmpr0d8p2yhsqhap3h3tfjt4x5lck2vjekpd7pz0ec6yunpqc3rcnhj) |
| **YakiHonne** | Unspecified | ❌ Not working in this test | A participant reported, “Not visible on yakihonne.” [Report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqs066f5dlcu5q3v7kfde2v3rppmgaul7tqugc04tsukzs0xqjan0pg8mxhd6) |
| **Nostur** | Apple platforms; exact platform not stated | ❌ Not working in this test | A participant reported, “Not visible on nostur,” and tagged the Nostur account. [Report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsz86h8yqdxhs4u0h546p90uuptt885gpp6nesx43teu0ve9868k0qgfjyqe) |
| **Nostrich** | Unspecified | ❌ Not working in the supplied screenshot | The reply contains only a screenshot. The screenshot shows the original Blossom URI as plain text, without the referenced image rendered. [Screenshot reply](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsy05p9hjfsnvthhml27h8mujyr2y3a7quqmnyzlakr56rpr7dwjzqansjs4) |
| **Dark Wisp** | Unknown | ❌ Not working | A participant reported that the image did not render, and the original poster subsequently confirmed that Dark Wisp is not working. [Original report](https://njump.me/nevent1qqsg0jt5phx9vua50c6zq9fhp8gu3atz9hsmqffllc7yfgpka0v83zsca3psr) |
